split.split_rationale: Train (<=2016) fits weights & scalers; Validation (2017-2019) evaluates candidate eligibility & model selection; Calibration (2020, 2022) computes conformal non-conformity residuals; Test (2023-2025) provides clean out-of-sample evaluation.

persistence.disqualification_reason: Naive baseline; lacks predictive feature weighting.

lstm.disqualification_reason: Sequence starvation (T <= 25 annual steps); requires synthetic imputation for missing year 2021; high parameter initialization variance.

stgnn.disqualification_reason: Spatial graph sparsity on irregular DWLR networks; unverified edge assumptions; sequence starvation (T <= 25).

served_model.alignment_rationale: The served model is the exact model trained on <=2016 observations, for which the 90% conformal uncertainty radius was calibrated and empirically verified. Zero model mismatch exists.

model_alignment.alignment_note: The model served in production is the exact model trained on <=2016 observations, for which this calibration radius was derived and tested.

conformal.exchangeability_assumptions_and_limitati: Split conformal inference guarantees marginal coverage under exchangeability (i.i.d.) between calibration and test data. In non-stationary hydrological systems subject to decadal rainfall trends and deepening groundwater draft, future coverage may deviate from nominal 90% if exchangeability is violated. Reported empirical coverage reflects performance on the 2023–2025 test holdout.
conformal.note: Calibrated on distinct temporal calibration holdout (2020, 2022) of selected Linear Regression model. Evaluated on unseen 2023–2025 test holdout.

multi_horizon_evaluation.description: Multi-horizon recursive evaluation executed from fixed origin T0 = 2022 across an identical cohort of 276 stations observed continuously in 2023, 2024, and 2025. Autoregressive predictions are fed back into lag features with actual observation calendar years.

horizon_1.input_features: True historical pre-monsoon lags through origin 2022

horizon_2.input_features: 1-year recursive prediction fed back into lag_1 (2023)
horizon_2.uncertainty_note: Multi-horizon recursive uncertainty calibration is unavailable.

horizon_3.input_features: 1-year & 2-year recursive predictions fed back into lag_1 (2024) and lag_2 (2023)
horizon_3.uncertainty_note: Multi-horizon recursive uncertainty calibration is unavailable.

multi_horizon_evaluation.error_trajectory_summary: On the common cohort (n=276) from origin 2022, MAE is 1.518m at h=1 (2023), increases to 1.855m at h=2 (2024, +22.19%), and is 1.730m at h=3 (2025, +14.0% vs h=1).

model_notes.historical_source: CGWB pre-monsoon Karnataka extraction from Pre-monsoon_WL_1994-2025.pdf
model_notes.trend_feature_physics: gwl_slope_4 calculated using actual calendar years, properly accounting for multi-year gaps (including missing year 2021).
model_notes.data_leakage_safeguards: Strictly chronological 4-way split. Imputers and scalers fitted strictly on training observations (<= 2016). Validation set never used for conformal calibration.
